invariants.statement: Each claimed editor family resolves at least one completion row.
No AI-backed row carries full-semantic trust weight.
No local-word row carries full-semantic trust weight.
Every row's trust weight equals the weight pinned to its assist class.
Every acceptable row with an additional-edit cue discloses it before commit.
Rows whose acceptance changes generated output or a dependency require preview.
Every degraded provider posture carries a visible fallback label and flags disclosure.
At least one surface exposes both a deterministic and an AI-backed row, and their assist class and trust weight differ.
Every row carries a non-empty source label so provider/source is visible.
Each snapshot's canonical assist list has one item per row with the same source and id.
Every deprecated or unavailable row carries a non-color marker and visual distinction.
Every row requiring visual distinction carries a non-empty non-color differentiator.
Every row that must disclose before commit carries a summary or requires preview.
Every unavailable row resolves to an inspect-only acceptance posture.
Every assist class appears at least once across the surfaces.

summary: Completion-row model frozen: 30 rows across 10 editor families; deterministic, cached, local-word, snippet, and AI classes stay distinct with pinned trust weights, every additional-edit/import effect discloses before commit, and every degraded provider posture is labeled.
